instruction: Decline tomorrow's 1:1 with Jordan and suggest Thursday instead.
final_text:
I declined tomorrow's Jordan / Sam 1:1 (Wed 30 Sep, 3:30–4:00pm), and Jordan was notified. My note asked to move it to Thursday at the same time, 3:30–4:00pm, and said you're happy to find another time if that doesn't work.

Your Thursday calendar is free then: it falls between Investor update prep (2–3pm) and the Hiring sync (4–5pm). Jordan set up the 1:1, so it's up to Jordan to reschedule it.
